compute.reported_as: Introduction: Exploiting the SU(2) symmetry of the model [50-53], we keep up to 20000 SU(2) states, (typically equivalent to ≳ 80000 U(1) states). ... Method: For small bond dimensions (χ ≲ 2000) we use the two-site version of the DMRG, and switch to the one-site variant to optimize the wave function for larger χ. ... we use the reliable two-site variance estimation to extrapolate towards the error-free case [56], because calculation of the full variance would be impractical due to its cost. It turns out that even the calculation of the two-site variance becomes too costly for clusters with more than ∼ 100 sites and bond dimensions ≳ 8000. In certain cases, we revert to the usage of the two-site DMRG and extrapolate as a function of the truncation error (cf. 108-site cluster). ... Fig. 5 caption: The corresponding maximal bond dimensions for the 32, 64, 108 and 128-site clusters are 20000, 16000, 16000 and 12000 respectively. ... Given the scaling of the computational effort with system size, the study of much larger clusters with the present method is, however, out of reach. ... Acknowledgments: Some of the data presented here was produced using the SyTen toolkit, originally created by Claudius Hubig.
compute.source: Introduction (max SU(2) states); Methods paragraphs; Fig. 5 caption (maximal bond dimension per cluster); Acknowledgments, arXiv:2010.03563 (compute pass 2026-09-16)
compute.note: bond_dimension = maximal SU(2) bond dimension stated for the 128-site cluster (Fig. 5 caption; the paper-wide maximum is 20000 SU(2) states ≈ ≳80000 U(1) states); the row energy is the χ→∞ extrapolation (linear in the two-site variance) of the finite-χ series up to that value. compute.source: Sec. VI Acknowledgements (device); Supplemental Material Sec. I.B (fij sublattice), arXiv:2311.11561 (compute pass 2026-09-16)
compute.note: No GPU/CPU-hours, node counts or wall-clock stated anywhere; the only hardware statement is the Fugaku/ISSP acknowledgement, which does not say which runs used which machine. Parameter count not stated as a number: mVMC pair-product fij with a 16-site fij sublattice (paper: M x Ns independent fij with M = 16, plus the RBM {a_i, b_k, W_ik} for the -RBM rows; no count given), so parameters left null. Variance extrapolation (SM Sec. V.A): "Linear extrapolation to zero variance has been done for 20 to 40 statistically independent measurements of the energy-eigenvalues from a singly optimized wave function". Energies are Tables SI-SIII of the SM. Fig. 14 (L = 2, Ns = 128 initial-state screening, "simple optimization, omitting elaborated optimization with RBM projection and Lanczos steps") runs 4000 optimization steps (inset shows 2000 <= i <= 4000); the PDF text layer of Fig. 14 also contains what looks like a leftover mVMC input file (NSROptItrStep: 4000, NSROptItrSmp: 200, NVMCSample 20, NVMCWarmUp 500, DSROptStepDt 0.02, NSRCG 1) that is not part of the visible caption and is not tied to the Table SI numbers; not used to fill fields.
